title: Nine Lessons of Teaching
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：chemistry　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chemistry 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to teach ① chemistry she could not love, and she said the teaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② chemistry, meaning the subject and not the laboratory, was nine lessons long and was taught by whoever came last; chemistry, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chemistry in that school had the same smell, and the ④ chemistry at the end, meaning the one the examiner kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever taught properly. Chemistry, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chemistry was the whole of the century, meaning the change it carried and not the subject. The ⑥ chemistry, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody studies and nobody questions; chemistry, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a subject and a change. She said the change is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ chemistry had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the smell. The ⑧ chemistry of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine lessons and eleven years of teaching; chemistry, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chemistry I remember is the one at the end, which was taught in 1973 and is still described as the hardest in the county. A ⑩ chemistry, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being taught; every chemistry, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a subject. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 化学（指那门学科本身，与那间实验室相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach chemistry 教化学
D. n. 化学课（指那所学校里每一门）
E. n. 化学课（指末尾那一门）
F. n. 变化之学（抽象：它承载的那场变化）
G. n. 那场变化（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chemistry, meaning the subject and not the laboratory
chemistry was the whole of the century
the chemistry had become a number in a report
The chemistry of the whole thing
A chemistry, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: teach chemistry 意为“教化学”，1953 年母亲被派去教她热爱不起来的那门化学。
chemistry 意为“化学”，指那门学科本身而不是那间实验室，共九节课，由最后来的人教。
chemistry 指那所学校里每一门化学课，每一门都是同样的气味。
chemistry 指末尾那一门（考官保留的那一门），是唯一有人认真教过的。
chemistry 意为“变化之学”，抽象指它承载的那场变化，父亲说 chemistry 就是那个世纪的全部。
chemistry 为抽象用法，指那场变化本身，是一个世纪里人人都研究、却没人质疑的东西。
chemistry 意为“化学”，到 1968 年这门 chemistry 成了报告里的一个数字。
chemistry 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九节课和十一年的教学。
chemistry 意为“化学课”，我记得的是末尾那一门，1973 年教过，至今仍被说成全县最难的。
chemistry 为抽象总称，祖母说一门化学是唯一会因为被认真教学而变好的东西。
